format.formulaSum: Take one exam from the Exam 1 list and one from the Exam 2 list. Total score = Exam 1 + Exam 2.
format.formulaWeighted: Take one exam from the main list and one from the second list. Score = {primary} × main + {secondary} × second.
format.cutOffNote: The cut-off is the minimum score to compete for a place. Popular programs may need a higher score to get in.
format.differentFromFirst: (not the one you chose for Exam 1)
format.differentFromPrimary: (not the one you chose as your main exam)
format.estimateNote: Fees marked ≈ are yearly estimates, not official amounts.

problem.title: We ran into the same problem
problem.description: When our admission year came, we spent hours searching just like everyone else. Information was scattered everywhere, and it was hard to tell what was current and what was out of date.
problem.sitesText: Every school has its own site, and the details are spread across different pages.
problem.socialText: Important announcements get buried in posts and group chats, and they're hard to find.
problem.separateText: You look up tuition, majors, entrance exam cut-offs and scholarships separately.
problem.timeText: Comparing schools can eat up hours, even days.

solution.title: Before and now

1.after: Clear cards with the same layout

2.after: Collected from official sites, rules and announcements

3.before: Tuition, exams and scholarships looked up separately
3.after: Tuition, cut-offs and scholarships in one place

4.after: Compare side by side, then decide

solution.closingMuted: We don't make the choice for you.
solution.closing: We just put the right information in one place.

trust.title: Our data comes from the schools' official websites and admission rules.

what.question: What is Oyutan MN?
what.answer: A platform that brings together admissions info for Mongolian universities and colleges — cut-off scores, majors, tuition, scholarships and admission dates — in one place.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes, completely free. Creating an account is free too.

source.question: Where does the information come from?
source.answer: We collect it from the schools' official websites, admission rules and announcements.

official.question: Is this an official site?
official.answer: No. We're an independent platform, not affiliated with any school. Always confirm the final details on the school's own website.

updates.question: How often is it updated?
updates.answer: Whenever new admission information is announced. Last updated: {date}.

report.question: How do I report wrong information?
report.answer: Email us at <link>{email}</link> and we'll check and fix it.

team.title: Built by students, for students
team.story1: We're high school students. The idea came to us while we were jumping from site to site and group to group, trying to choose a university.
team.story2: We believe every student in Mongolia, whatever their school or city, deserves the same accurate information, for free.

tour.title: What can you do here?
tour.description: Everything you need for admissions, collected from the schools' official sources and shown in one consistent format.
tour.schoolsText: Filter by location, tuition, dorms and scholarships to find the school you need.
tour.majorsTitle: Find majors by your exam score
tour.majorsText: Enter your entrance exam (ЭЕШ) score and see the majors whose cut-off you meet.
tour.compareText: Put two or three schools side by side by tuition, cut-off scores and scholarships.
tour.calendarText: Keep track of open scholarships and upcoming deadlines so you never miss one.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This is a draft of our privacy policy. The content may change before the final version is published.
privacy.stored1: We use your email address when you sign up. Once you're signed in, we store the schools and majors you save and the entrance exam scores you add to your profile.
privacy.stored2: To count site visits, we create a random number for each browser that contains no personal information.
privacy.use1: Only to show you what you've saved and to suggest majors that match your scores. We never sell your information.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: This is a draft of our terms of service. The content may change before the final version is published.
terms.what1: Oyutan MN is a free, independent platform that brings university admissions information together in one place. We are not the official site of any school.
terms.accuracy1: We collect information from the schools' official websites and admission rules, but mistakes or outdated details can happen. Meeting a cut-off score doesn't guarantee admission. Always confirm the final details on the school's website before you apply.
